# Figure 3 — The A2 exhibit and the six-beat loop that repairs it

## Caption (this is what the paper prints)

**Figure 3. The A2 exhibit and the six-beat loop that repairs it.** The beat flow M0 -> M5 -> L1 … L6, each beat carrying its status and its one decisive number, over an account strip of environment actions spent. At M5 the manual replays the play record at 100%, Lean signs an axiom-free `unsolvable` theorem, and the world contradicts it -- the co-occurrence of those three facts is the whole DC22 phenomenon.
